recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white profile portrait of a bearded man wearing a wide-brimmed hat, framed by a thick, vibrant yellow border containing bold, condensed black typography that wraps around the edges.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome subject against a neutral gray background
Vibrant yellow perimeter frame acting as a typographic container
Text orientation following the vertical and horizontal axes of the frame
Subject's profile gaze directed toward the left edge of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait centered horizontally, slightly cropped at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's eye and the textured band of the hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the profile face, moves to the hat's texture, then follows the yellow border clockwise around the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Gray stippled background behind the subject provides breathing room within the yellow frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Monochrome (Black and White) for the central photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Yellow for the perimeter frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for the typography within the yellow frame.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow creates a sharp boundary against the desaturated, high-contrast center.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in multiple orientations for rhythmic consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the original.
Provides the necessary grotesque feel and verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white profile portrait of a man with a beard and a wide-brimmed felt hat against a grainy gray background. Surround the image with a thick, solid yellow border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed black uppercase sans-serif text inside the yellow border, rotating the text to follow the top, right, and left edges of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the text oriented correctly along the border edges?
Is the yellow border a consistent width?
Is the central portrait high-contrast monochrome?
Does the text fill the border without touching the inner image?

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast between yellow and black/white
Clean typographic alignment within the frame
Visible texture in the hat and beard

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the central image.
Verify the yellow is a flat, solid color.
Check that the portrait maintains a 70s-style film grain.
Confirm the typography is strictly uppercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + Solid yellow perimeter frame + Condensed black sans-serif wrap-around text.
